title: Data & Reporting Analyst
description:
Data & Reporting Analyst - (SAP Analytics Cloud)

Location: Birmingham | Salary: £45K | Hybrid Working: 2/3 days onsite per week

I'm working with a well-established organisation looking to recruit a commercially minded Data & Reporting Analyst to play a key role in improving how data is captured, reported and used to drive business decisions.

Strong experience with SAP Analytics Cloud or a similar reporting and analytics platform is essential, particularly developing sophisticated dashboards and analytical reports. Experience working within a Finance team or wider Finance environment would also be highly desirable.

Sitting within the Finance function but working closely with stakeholders across the wider business, you'll take ownership of key reporting tools, developing dashboards, improving data quality and translating complex information into meaningful, actionable insights.

The role:

  • Develop and maintain dashboards, data models and reporting solutions for management teams across multiple departments.

  • Review and consolidate business reporting, improving accessibility and bringing information together within a central platform.

  • Take ownership of data integrity, identifying issues and driving corrections at source.

  • Deliver meaningful analysis and insights to support strategic and operational decision-making.

  • Coordinate testing of new data products, including UAT and quality assurance.

  • Support and train colleagues on reporting tools, data quality and best practice.

  • Continuously improve the user experience, accessibility and effectiveness of reporting solutions.

  • Work closely with stakeholders to identify opportunities for improved reporting and data-driven decision-making.

What I'm looking for:

  • Proven experience developing complex operational and analytical reports using SAP Analytics Cloud or similar reporting/BI tools.

  • Experience producing dashboards and reporting solutions for varied audiences across multiple business functions.

  • Previous experience working within a Finance team or Finance environment would be advantageous.

  • Understanding of data modelling, business analysis and data governance.

  • Experience coordinating UAT, testing and quality assurance processes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.

  • Confident communicator, comfortable translating technical information into business-friendly insights.

  • A proactive, commercially minded individual who can challenge stakeholders, influence decisions and drive continuous improvement.

The opportunity:

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys getting under the skin of business data, improving reporting capabilities and having a genuine influence on how an organisation makes decisions.

If you're an analytical, driven reporting professional with strong BI and reporting experience, I'd be keen to hear from you.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.
